ctbids-48681-5676923.description:
Worn and appreciated by Warren Winiarski is this exceptional example of Swiss luxury watchmaking, this distinguished Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control Chronograph combines timeless elegance, precision engineering, and the refined craftsmanship of one of Switzerland’s most prestigious watchmakers.
Beautifully crafted in 18K solid gold, this sophisticated timepiece features a champagne-silver dial with three recessed chronograph subdials, elegant gold-tone hands, applied hour markers, and a date window positioned between 4 and 5 o’clock.
The dial also features a pulsometer scale, historically used to measure heart rate, adding a distinctive element of traditional horological craftsmanship.
The caseback is adorned with the iconic Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control medallion, celebrating the manufacturer’s renowned watchmaking heritage. Completing this elegant timepiece is a black leather band with contrasting stitching and a Jaeger-LeCoultre signed 18K gold deployant clasp, bearing the “750” gold purity hallmark.
Highlights:
- Brand: Jaeger-LeCoultre (JLC)
- Collection: Master Control
- Style: Luxury chronograph wristwatch
- Case: 18K solid gold, marked 750
- Dial: Champagne-silver with gold-tone accents
- Movement: Swiss mechanical chronograph
- Functions: Three chronograph subdials, pulsometer scale, and date display
- Caseback: Engraved Master Control medallion
- Clasp: Jaeger-LeCoultre signed 18K gold deployant clasp, stamped 750
- Reference Number: 174.2.C1 (as marked on caseback)
- Swiss Made
Condition: Pre-owned condition with visible surface scratches, scuffs, and signs of age and use, particularly on the gold case and clasp. The leather band exhibits wear consistent with previous use.
Working condition has not been verified. Chronograph operation, timekeeping accuracy, and service history are unknown. Professional inspection or servicing may be required. Mmovement type not independently verified Sold AS-IS.

Please review all photographs carefully for details of condition, markings, and overall appearance.
This item has a $5,000 reserve, however, please make your highest bid as we will consider selling for less should the reserve not be met.

Vintage Bent-Stem Tobacco Pipe Light Brown Wood Brass Band Scrollwork
Vintage tobacco smoking pipe with a bent-stem design and bulbous bowl made of light brown wood, likely briar. The bowl and shank feature ornate embossed brass or gold-tone metal banding with scrollwork and floral motifs. The black stem is curved with a bit end, possibly made of vulcanite or horn. The pipe shows signs of age and use including wear on the finish, darkened areas inside the bowl rim, and residue or wear marks on the metal band and stem joint area. No visible brand markings are present, indicating it may be an unmarked or antique estate pipe. 5.5x1.5
